missing_points: Method 1: Press the Stop button on the keypad or set control mode to Manual, then address the fault condition and restart
Method 2: Cycle the drive power completely OFF then back ON after confirming the fault condition has been corrected and load is secured
Method 3: Use a digital input terminal (e.g., terminal block inputs used for fault clear command via drive configuration) to signal fault clear after root cause is addressed
The safest method in production is Method 2 (power cycle) after confirming the fault condition has been corrected and the motor load is secured
correctness.note: The answer correctly abstains from overclaiming, but it does not provide the three requested methods or identify the safest one.

grounding.note: The cited excerpts support only manual reset for an external fault and auto/manual reset for STO faults; they do not support the three-method framework in the rubric.

actionability.note: It explains why it cannot answer exactly from the excerpts and asks for the full section or fault code, but it does not answer the user’s question.

uncertainty.note: High confidence because the response is clearly limited to the cited excerpts and does not claim unsupported methods.
